science_question: Does frozen BZ learned relational binding beat an EQUALLY informed, fully trained nibble-binding competitor with equal capacity and complete training/native CPU+RSS cost, without creating synthetic science claims?

control.name: CA-MATCH learned exact-symbol binding competitor
control.mechanism: Source-blind permutation+odd-gain nibble binding and optional output XOR relation using same 31 variable state bits + one reserved zero as BZ; trains independently by exhaustive 24 permutation ×2 relation layouts, 25 gain candidates ×40 FIT per layout, with residual hist and FIT exact-NIBBLE mismatch objective. The BZ candidate uses bit-error objective. Loss difference frozen BEFORE new source origination, not optimized after seeing results.
control.frozen_training_count: 48,000 FIT residuals + 48,000 scored nibble evaluations per task; same as BZ, no use of BZ.learn. CHECK can veto only, same 6 FIT / 2 CHECK bit-error admission ceilings to preserve original confidence. A first-best by exact-nibble mismatches cannot be retuned after testing. Equal ties -> abstain, no favorable case replacement.
control.training_budget_policy: All public 40 FIT, 8 CHECK, entire model fit, graph processing and native scorer memory and CPU charged at measured original process level; include all temporary data and worst-case RSS; 32-bit state and same 7 active/9 retained maximum.

original_source_neutral_fixture.selection: exact only two preregistered engineering pairs; two different held-separate reversible 4-nibble permutation/gate instances; seven/nine graph hops, nine disconnected decoys, one symbolic positive and inventory/topology-matched hard false. No old source or old unit-test observations re-used.
original_source_neutral_fixture.admission: Freeze candidate+control before these source-neutral cases are first constructed. If candidate or control abstains, retain original negative/ineligible; do NOT adjust loss, tie threshold, seeds or source.
original_source_neutral_fixture.native_work: AZ natural policy may abstain; if so mark AZ-ineligible and never invoke forced native scorer. BZ and CA must BOTH naturally accept from FIT/CHECK and score positive/negative with same normalized native graph and score/raw/ratio/work; if not same, mark matched-workload ineligible and never claim true matched CPU parity.
original_source_neutral_fixture.measure: All original arms AZ, BQ, BX, BZ and CA, five fresh Linux whole-process CPU/RSS samples per arm per case (50 total). All 40 FIT+8 CHECK, training, public parsing, native scores, conversion, allocations and OS peak RSS included. No selective sampling. Original CPU median + peak RSS median and max per arm. 32-bit state comparisons only if same actual native work; compare BZ CPU median <= *strongest trained eligible* control and RSS median AND max <= it, on each case.
original_source_neutral_fixture.authority: Only engineering synthetic qualification. Never run any previously consumed BY, BX, BU, BQ, BM/BP/BN/BO or old 192 TRAIN. Never generate F124-BV original 924xxx,925xxx or protected 128x2.

disposition_on_fail: Record original 50 whole process observations and all abstentions, native-work mismatches and cost regressions; do NOT reclassify failed matched resource parity or new source evidence.
